headline: Battle Belt Widens as Marban, Gutter Stir
war_summary: The latest returns show the contested belt broadening since the last edition. Gutter has risen from 83 to 91 strategic-base events in 24 hours, though its immediate casualty and enlistment rates have cooled; its holdings remain entirely Colonial. MarbanHollow has made the sharpest advance in activity, climbing from 21 to 30 events, with five recorded in the latest two hours and a divided ledger of four Warden, three Colonial, and one neutral base. WeatheredExpanse has edged from 50 to 51 events, including three in the latest two hours, while casualties remain heavy and both sides still hold four and three bases respectively, with two neutral. OlavisWake now stands at 14 events, up from the previous report’s eight, and recorded three recent changes amid a mixed five-base ledger. PalantineBerm remains at 25 daily events but has seen no fresh change in the latest six hours. KuuraStrand is the newest sharp flare, with two events in two hours, accelerating casualties and enlistments, and five Warden bases against one Colonial. Several rear sectors remain quiet; no victor is declared.
